subject: Accelerator credit request — Skybridge Spring 2026 cohort
messages:
From: Samira Ahmed <samira@skybridgeaccelerator.org>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Evan Cho <evan@greenloop.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Feb 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro — Skybridge Spring cohort (credits request)

Hi Marissa,

Hope you’re doing well. I run partnerships at Skybridge Accelerator — we’re kicking off our Spring 2026 cohort and would love to explore a startup program partnership with Redwood. Last cycle we gave portfolio startups credits from our cloud partners which materially helped them iterate and decide on hosting.

High level ask: 50 companies in the cohort, roughly 1–3 engineers each, early-stage (pre-seed to seed). We’re hoping Redwood can provide promotional trial credits (suggested: $3,000 USD per startup) and a short qualification path so teams can onboard quickly.

I attached a draft cohort list (names anonymized) and can share more once we do an NDA if needed. Would Redwood consider this type of accelerator credit and an API onboarding playbook for the cohort?

Thanks — happy to set a 30-min sync.

— Samira
Partnerships | Skybridge Accelerator
attachments: skybridge_cohort_spring2026.csv (CSV, 42KB)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samira Ahmed <samira@skybridgeaccelerator.org>
Cc: Evan Cho <evan@greenloop.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Feb 2026 15:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro — Skybridge Spring cohort (credits request)

Hi Samira — great to meet you and congrats on the new cohort. This is exactly the type of partner program we support. A couple quick clarifying Qs so I can scope this and loop in financing/partnerships: 

- Is the $3k per startup a one-time promotional credit applied to hosted API usage?
- Any restrictions on how startups spend credits (e.g., embeddings vs. generation workloads)?
- What’s your target activation window after credits are issued (30/60/90 days)?
- Do you want a single master agreement or individual T&Cs per startup?

If it’s okay, I’ll tee this up with Aditya (partnership approvals) and Sean (channel sales) to request a promo above our self-serve threshold and confirm legal/billing. Happy to hop on a short call tomorrow.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Evan Cho <evan@greenloop.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, Samira Ahmed <samira@skybridgeaccelerator.org>
Date: Tue, 03 Feb 2026 09:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro — Skybridge Spring cohort (credits request)

Thanks Marissa — quick answers from our side:
- Yes, $3k is a one-time credit intended to cover API usage during initial MVP and demo work.
- We expect most teams to use generation + embeddings for prototypes; no strict enforcement but prefer credits cover standard API usage only (no infra or managed deployment fees).
- Activation: ideally 60 days after credit issuance since some teams onboard slower.
- We prefer a single Master MSA with an accelerator addendum that covers issuance and reporting.

I attached a sample cohort roster (anonymized emails) so you can see scale. Happy to join a 30-min to walk through if helpful.

— Evan
Founder, GreenLoop Labs (Skybridge portfolio)
attachments: skybridge_cohort_spring2026.csv (CSV)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 03 Feb 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Intro — Skybridge Spring cohort (credits request)

Aditya / Sean — forwarding Skybridge request. Ask: 50 startups x $3k = $150k in promotional credits. This is above our usual accelerator playbook cap; we typically do $25k–75k per program.

Proposed structure:
- $3k one-time credit per company applied to hosted API usage only (no Dedicated or Private credit).
- 60-day activation window from issuance.
- Single Master MSA with appendix for reporting and anti-abuse.

Can we approve $150k in credits as a marketing/partnership spend? If not, what counter would we offer (e.g., $1.5k per company or tiered credits for top 20)? Also looping Tessa for billing/logistics on issuance and tracking.

Forwarded message below.

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 03 Feb 2026 11:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Intro — Skybridge Spring cohort (credits request)

Thanks for the context Marissa. I’m supportive of the partner motion — accelerators are high-leverage. A couple considerations before greenlighting $150k:
- Need a short fraud/abuse plan (email verification + limit of one redeemed credit per payment instrument).
- Finance wants the credits to hit a specific partner budget line; Tessa, can you confirm if we have runway in Q1 partnership budget or whether marketing covers a portion?
- Legal: master MSA + addendum is fine; we’ll provide a standard accelerator appendix.

If finance is constrained I’m OK with a counter: $1,500 per company for all 50, plus a top-20 bonus of an extra $1,500 each redeemable by milestone (demo day or partner nomination). That gets us to $75k + $30k = $105k effective.

If you can confirm cohort roster and an onboarding timeline I’ll sign off pending Tessa’s budget confirmation.

On Tue, Feb 3, 2026 at 10:02 AM marissa_cole@redwood.com wrote:
> Aditya / Sean — forwarding Skybridge request. Ask: 50 startups x $3k = $150k in promotional credits.

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 04 Feb 2026 08:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Intro — Skybridge Spring cohort (credits request)

I reviewed the Q1 partnership budgets — we have $60k earmarked for accelerator/partner credits but can flex up to $90k with marketing cost-share. Given that, I approve the counter-proposal:
- $1,500 credit per company for all 50 startups = $75k (finance covers $60k, marketing to cover $15k).
- Bonus pool: additional $1,500 for up to 20 startups tied to milestones (demo day nomination) to be paid after validation = $30k (marketing covers entire bonus pool).

Requirements:
- Validate startup identity via accelerator-provided roster with official emails (no personal domains).
- Single-use redemption per startup; credits expire 90 days after issuance.
- Addendum must include reporting cadence (monthly redemption report).

I’ll attach a promo_approval_draft for record and will work with billing to set up partner promo codes.

Tessa Morgan
Head of Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
attachments: promo_approval_draft.pdf (PDF, 88KB)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samira Ahmed <samira@skybridgeaccelerator.org>, Evan Cho <evan@greenloop.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 04 Feb 2026 11:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro — Skybridge Spring cohort (credits request)

Hi Samira / Evan — great news. Redwood can participate and we’re prepared to support the full cohort with the following approved structure: 

- Base credit: $1,500 one-time credit per company for 50 startups (total base pool = $75k).
- Bonus credits: $1,500 each for up to 20 startups tied to demo-day nomination (total bonus pool = $30k).
- Credit expiration: 90 days after issuance. Activation window: redeemable within 60 days.
- Eligibility: startups must be on the accelerator roster with company email domains and one redeeming engineer per startup.
- Delivery: Redwood will issue partner promo codes and provide a short onboarding playbook; monthly redemption reports will be shared.

Next steps from Skybridge: please share the official roster (company name + company email) and preferred timing for issuance. I’ll send a draft accelerator addendum and a DocuSign link today for signature and include HubSpot deal RDW-ACC-2026-048 for tracking.

Thanks — excited to partner on this cohort.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Partnerships | Redwood Inference
